title: McCartney and Starr reunite for rare Beatles performance at 2027 Las Vegas charity concert
summary_full: Mark your calendars for a spectacular night on January 29, 2027, as Paul McCartney and Ringo Starr grace the stage at MGM Grand Arena. This charity concert celebrates VetsAid's anniversary, featuring notable performances from The Killers and St. Vincent. Proceeds will provide vital support for military veterans and their families. Tickets will be available shortly, offering special discounts for active-duty members and veterans.
